title: Design Verification Engineer
summary: Proves a chip block or SoC works before it is made, by building simulation testbenches that throw millions of random tests at the design and measure what has been covered. Sits beside the RTL designers in a semiconductor team and signs off each block for tape-out.
dailyDuties: Write and update the verification plan for a block
Build UVM agents, sequences and scoreboards
Debug failing tests from waveforms and file bugs with designers
Run nightly regressions and triage failures
Review coverage holes and write tests to close them

skills.expectation: Build SystemVerilog UVM testbenches with agents, sequences, scoreboards and assertions
Write the verification plan for a block and drive regressions to coverage closure
Read RTL and debug failing tests from waveforms in VCS, Xcelium or Questa
Understand FSMs, FIFOs, arbiters and clock domains well enough to find design bugs
Verify on-chip bus protocols such as AXI, AHB and APB
Run and triage regressions on Linux servers
Automate regressions and triage in Perl or Tcl
Automate regressions and triage in Python
Write properties and prove them with formal tools such as JasperGold
Write C++ reference models and DPI hooks for the testbench
Write C tests that run on the SoC's embedded cores
Run power-aware simulations with the design's UPF
Keep testbench code in version control and review changes

groups.label: A flow scripting language (Tcl/Perl or Python)
